victim_self_allowance_set.meaning: victim has set a self-allowance via permit, satisfying spendSelfAllowance

caller_owner_allowance_absent.meaning: attacker has no allowance from the victim (owner-to-caller allowance is zero/absent)

assets_transferred_to_attacker_occurred.meaning: underlying assets were transferred to the attacker as a result of the redeem

assumptions: The attacker is an arbitrary external caller distinct from the victim/owner.
The victim's self-allowance is a pre-existing state before the attacker's redeem call.
The redeem call is the protected action that moves the victim's underlying assets.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's redeem call actually succeeded in a real transaction; the scenario is described as a capability, so the impact occurrence is symbolic.

limitations: Only the direct impact assets_transferred_to_attacker is formalized; victim_funds_lost is deferred to a future claim.
The root cause missing_caller_allowance_check is not encoded as P; it is the mechanism behind the selected impact.
Exact share and asset amounts are unspecified and not needed for this access-control relation.
Code/PoC binding and concrete transaction success are deferred.
